This workflow achieves more complex occlusion repainting effects, enhancing the interaction between the product and other elements. It allows for better integration of the product and ensures consistent lighting and shadows.

The process is very simple. You only need to draw the parts you want to mask in the mask editor. It needs to be used with the snap-specific Lora image generator.

The workflow is divided into three modules:

Brushnet Repainting
IC_Light Light and Shadow Blending
Supir High-Definition Upscaling
In the Brushnet Repainting area, use mask changes to achieve the occlusion relationship between the product and secondary elements. Then, use IC_Light to adjust the light and shadow in the image, creating color and shadow consistency. Finally, use Supir to enhance the image details.
